name: platformer_game
spec: Create a 2D platformer game using Python and Pygame. The player controls a character that can run and jump across platforms, collect coins, and avoid enemies. The game should have gravity physics, multiple levels, and a health system. Levels are defined in a simple data format so multiple levels can be loaded.
features: A pygame window opens displaying a side-view platformer level
A player character is rendered and can move left and right with arrow keys
The player can jump with the spacebar and is affected by gravity
The player lands on and stands on solid platforms at various heights
Platforms are rendered as solid colored rectangles at defined positions
Collectible coins are placed on platforms and the player picks them up on contact
A coin counter is displayed on screen and updates when coins are collected
Enemy characters patrol back and forth on platforms
The player takes damage and loses health when touching an enemy
A health bar or health display is shown on screen
The game ends when health reaches zero with a game over screen
At least 3 distinct levels are included with different platform layouts
The player advances to the next level by reaching a goal point at the end
A camera or viewport scrolls horizontally to follow the player
